sources.name: EMA Article 57 public product data
sources.licence: EMA reproduction notice; acknowledge EMA in each copy
sources.limits: Reported authorisation country, not commercial availability. No licence numbers, approval dates or complete historical register in this extract. Northern Ireland remains separately scoped. Substance expressions and routes are preserved; contacts and PSMF locations are excluded.
sources.sourceDateMeaning: Article 57 data-as-present date; not approval date

sources.name: France · Base de données publique des médicaments
sources.licence: Licence Ouverte; retain source, update date and meaning
sources.limits: BDPM published specialty scope; not every historical French authorisation. CIS identifies the specialty, not a package CIP. Authorisation and commercialisation statuses remain separate. Only active-substance composition rows are used.

sources.name: UK MHRA · Category 1 and 2 product lists
sources.licence: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0; © Crown copyright
sources.limits: Category-list snapshot; excludes Northern Ireland-only MAs, traditional herbal and simplified homeopathic registrations, parallel imports, unlicensed and investigational medicines. Multiple substance rows are grouped only by licence, holder and exact product name. Listing date is not approval date.
sources.sourceDateMeaning: Authorisations in effect on date stated by MHRA category-list page

sources.name: Brazil ANVISA · Open medicine registration data
sources.licence: ANVISA open data; source attribution retained
sources.limits: Active and inactive registration/process records. Process completion is not automatically original approval. Registration expiry is month precision when supplied. Inactive does not establish safety withdrawal. Exact duplicate selected facts are collapsed; source row counts remain available.
sources.sourceDateMeaning: HTTP Last-Modified for ANVISA export, when supplied

sources.name: Taiwan FDA · All drug licences open dataset
sources.licence: Open Government Data License, version 1.0 (Taiwan); source attribution retained
sources.limits: Includes cancelled licences and source product classes. Issue date is a licence issue date, not proven original medicine approval. Blank cancellation status does not establish current validity. Addresses, contact and personal information fields are excluded.
sources.sourceDateMeaning: HTTP Last-Modified for Taiwan export, when supplied

sources.name: Spain AEMPS · CIMA medicines API
sources.licence: AEMPS reproduction notice; retain origin and available update dates
sources.limits: Paginated medicine listing, not every historical presentation. Listing does not supply complete active-ingredient composition: therapeutic-moiety text is labelled separately. API date values use the documented GMT+02:00 convention. Label document timestamps are not regulatory change approvals.
sources.sourceDateMeaning: API has no whole-register snapshot timestamp; retrieval dates retained per page

scope: Source records, with overlap; not a complete national or worldwide inventory. No clinical-trial ownership or commercial availability inferred.
